title: Subsquare-root learning regime
statement: Let $n,C,Q$ be natural numbers, let $t$ be a positive rational, and let $\varepsilon$ be rational with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. The parameters lie in the subsquare-root regime when $1\le n$, $1/(Q+1)\le\varepsilon$, and $t\le (C+1)(\sqrt{\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1)$, where the logarithmic quantity is rounded up to an integer before taking its square root.
